name: ProgressRing
description: A circular SVG progress indicator whose arc and center percentage tween smoothly to each new value, with an optional two-color gradient stroke, soft glow, rounded caps and a caption.
a11yNotes: The root has role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow (the target, not the tweening value), aria-valuetext as a percentage and aria-label from the caption. The SVG is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the value jumps without tweening.

propsApi.name: value
propsApi.description: Current progress, clamped between 0 and max; changes tween smoothly.

propsApi.name: color2
propsApi.description: Gradient end color, used when gradient is true.

propsApi.name: gradient
propsApi.description: Blend color into color2 along the arc.

propsApi.name: trackColor
propsApi.description: Track color; defaults to the theme border color.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Caption under the number; also the accessible name.

propsApi.name: showValue
propsApi.description: Show the percentage in the center.

propsApi.name: roundedCaps
propsApi.description: Round the ends of the progress arc.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Custom center content replacing the number and caption.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
